questions.prompt: A 2-socket compute node shows inconsistent memory latency on an in-memory database. `numactl --hardware` shows Node 0 and Node 1. What should you do?

options.text: Bind the database process and its memory allocation to a single NUMA node or enable interleaving intentionally, avoiding accidental cross-socket hops

questions.prompt: In a rack drawing `6.4 kW` on dual A/B `208V 30A` PDUs, why should each single feed stay below `50%` of its derated limit?

options.text: So if Feed A trips, Feed B can carry the entire `6.4 kW` rack load without tripping its breaker

questions.prompt: Match each hardware failure symptom to its most likely root cause.

rows.label: Rising corrected ECC counts in `edac-util` / BMC
Ethernet CRC/symbol errors on one port

columns.label: Degrading DRAM DIMM that should be scheduled for replacement before an uncorrectable crash
Damaged patch cable, dirty fiber ferrule, or failing SFP transceiver
Loose GPU/NVMe seating, dirty gold fingers, or failing riser/motherboard slot

questions.prompt: Why do **GPU training clusters** pair high-speed NVMe local scratch with **100GbE/InfiniBand** fabrics?

options.text: Slow storage or network stalls expensive GPUs waiting for training batches and all-reduce gradient sync

questions.prompt: Which practices prevent **storage array catastrophes** in production? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Using RAID 6 or RAID 10 instead of RAID 5 on large HDDs
Keeping hot spares + automated SMART alerting
Using RAID 0 for critical financial databases

questions.prompt: What is **write-back** vs. **write-through** controller caching without a battery/flash-backed unit (BBU)?

options.text: Write-back without BBU risks losing acknowledged writes in volatile cache on power loss; use BBU/PLP or write-through

questions.prompt: When troubleshooting **sudden server reboots**, what does the **BMC System Event Log (SEL)** reveal that OS logs (`journalctl`) might miss?

options.text: PSU rail brownouts, thermal trips, ECC uncorrectable errors, and watchdog resets that killed the OS before it could flush logs

questions.prompt: What is **cold-aisle containment** in a data center?

options.text: Enclosing cold supply air so it must pass through server intakes without mixing with hot exhaust air

questions.prompt: Why should **mixed-vendor or mismatched-rank DIMMs** be avoided in multi-channel servers?

options.text: Linux refuses to boot any mismatch
Mismatched speeds/ranks force the memory controller to downclock or drop out of optimal symmetric channel interleaving

questions.prompt: Which commands help audit **Linux hardware health** quickly during an incident? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: `ip -s link` / `ethtool -S` for NIC drops and errors
`dmesg -T -l err,crit` for kernel I/O and bus faults

questions.prompt: What is **PCIe retimer / switch** hardware used for in multi-GPU servers?

options.text: Maintaining signal integrity across long traces/risers and fanning out PCIe lanes to multiple GPUs/NVMe drives

questions.prompt: Why do **NVMe drives** drop write performance sharply once their **SLC pseudo-cache** fills up?

options.text: Sustained writes must go directly to slower TLC/QLC NAND and wait for garbage collection/erases

questions.prompt: Match each server component to its single-point-of-failure mitigation.

columns.label: Dual redundant hot-swap PSUs on separate A/B PDUs
Dual-port/dual-NIC LACP bond across two ToR switches
Hardware/ZFS/mdadm RAID-1 mirror for OS root

questions.prompt: What is **mean time between failures (MTBF)** vs. **annualized failure rate (AFR)**?

options.text: AFR estimates the percentage of a drive fleet expected to fail per year, useful for sparing capacity planning
MTBF guarantees a single drive will never fail before that hour

questions.prompt: Why is **direct-attached NVMe** faster than **networked SAN storage** for local scratch, and what is the trade-off?

options.text: Local NVMe avoids network hops and switch latency, but data is tied to that single host unless replicated

questions.prompt: Which checks belong in a **rack power & thermal audit**? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Checking A/B PDU load balance stays under single-feed breaker limits
Blocking rear exhaust fans with coiled power cables
Verifying front-to-back airflow direction matches all chassis in the row
Installing blanking panels in empty U slots to stop hot-air recirculation

questions.prompt: What does `iostat -xz 1` reveal about a storage bottleneck?

options.text: Per-device `%util`, queue depth (`aqu-sz`), `await` latency, and read/write MB/s

questions.prompt: Why is **4K alignment** important when partitioning HDDs/SSDs?

options.text: Misaligned partitions split single logical writes across two physical 4K sectors/pages, halving write performance

questions.prompt: What is **CXL (Compute Express Link)** emerging for in modern data centers?

options.text: Cache-coherent memory expansion and pooling over PCIe physical layers

questions.prompt: When **decommissioning** failed or retired server drives, what is the required security step?

options.text: Cryptographic erase / NIST SP 800-88 sanitize or physical shredding before disposal

questions.prompt: Which factors influence **total cost of ownership (TCO)** for compute hardware? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Ongoing power and cooling OpEx (Watts × PUE × kWh rate)

questions.prompt: What is **link flapping** on a network port?

options.text: A port repeatedly dropping and re-establishing link due to a bad cable, failing optic, or auto-negotiation fault

questions.prompt: What is **FEC (Forward Error Correction)** on 25G/100G/400G Ethernet links?

options.text: Adding redundant encoding bits so the receiver corrects minor line bit errors without retransmission

questions.prompt: Which command verifies negotiated speed, duplex, and link detection on Linux NIC `eth0`?
Match each backup/archive failure risk to its defense.

rows.label: Fire or flood at primary building

columns.label: Immutable / WORM object lock or offline air-gapped tape

questions.prompt: Why should **GPU servers** avoid sharing PCIe root complexes poorly when doing peer-to-peer (P2P) transfers?

options.text: Crossing CPU sockets or root complexes cuts P2P bandwidth and raises latency; use NVLink or same-switch PCIe topology

questions.prompt: What does `edac-util -v` (or `/sys/devices/system/edac`) monitor?

options.text: Corrected (CE) and uncorrectable (UE) ECC memory errors

questions.prompt: What is **write-hole** in traditional RAID 5/6 without a journal/BBU or ZFS RAID-Z?

options.text: A crash mid-stripe-write leaves data and parity out of sync, risking silent corruption on later rebuild
A physical hole in the platter

questions.prompt: What is **CPU pinning / core isolation** (`isolcpus` / `taskset`) used for?

options.text: Dedicating specific cores to latency-critical threads so OS housekeeping doesn't preempt them

questions.prompt: Which practices keep **cable management** in server racks serviceable? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Using cable-management arms or slack loops so servers slide out on rails without unplugging
Separating power cables on one side and data/fiber on the other
Color-coding and labeling both ends of every cable
Zip-tying fiber tightly around sharp 90-degree metal edges

questions.prompt: Why do **high-frequency trading / low-latency** NICs use **kernel bypass** (DPDK / Solarflare)?

options.text: Avoiding OS kernel context switches, interrupts, and buffer copies cuts packet latency to microseconds

questions.prompt: What is **ZFS / Btrfs scrubbing**?

options.text: Reading every data and parity block periodically and verifying checksums, healing silent errors from redundant copies

questions.prompt: Why should **UPS batteries** be tested and replaced on a schedule (typically every 3–5 years)?

options.text: Lead-acid/battery cells degrade silently and fail under load right when mains power drops

questions.prompt: What does `nvidia-smi topo -m` display on a multi-GPU node?

options.text: Interconnect matrix (NVLink, PCIe switch, NUMA affinity) between GPUs and NICs

questions.prompt: What is **silent data corruption**?

options.text: Bit flips in storage or memory that return wrong bytes without raising an I/O error

questions.prompt: Why is **consistent hardware SKU standardization** valuable in fleet operations?

options.text: It removes the need for backups
Shared spare parts, uniform firmware/driver baselines, and predictable thermal/power profiles simplify operations

questions.prompt: Which metrics belong in **hardware fleet capacity planning**? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: CPU, RAM, and VRAM utilization growth trends
Rack kW power and cooling headroom

questions.prompt: What is **Redfish** in modern server hardware management?

options.text: A modern RESTful HTTPS/JSON out-of-band management standard replacing legacy IPMI-over-LAN

questions.prompt: Why must **BMC/Redfish interfaces** NEVER be exposed directly to the public internet?

options.text: Out-of-band controllers hold full power, virtual-media, and console control over bare-metal hosts

questions.prompt: What is **PCIe Resizable BAR (ReBAR)**?

options.text: Allowing the CPU to map the GPU's full VRAM aperture rather than a legacy 256 MB window

questions.prompt: When diagnosing **intermittent packet loss** on a 10GbE fiber link, what is the quickest physical check?

options.text: Inspect optical TX/RX power levels (`ethtool -m`) and clean/swap the LC fiber patch & SFP+ transceiver

questions.prompt: What defines a **production-grade hardware architecture**?

options.text: Eliminating single points of failure, matching interconnects to workload bottlenecks, monitoring SMART/ECC/BMC telemetry, and testing recovery
Buying the cheapest consumer parts with no spares
Putting BMC ports on public IPs
